scope: The 16 technical groups with explicit OSM attribution in retained source evidence. This is not a blanket license declaration for all meshes, textures, documentation or rendered images.

Way version 5, updated 2020-09-28. Mapped envelope 46.34 × 49.03 m; modeled simplified structural envelope 46.4 × 49.0 m. This is community-map evidence, not measured survey. The small courtyard notch is simplified; exact geographicplacement is not asserted.

A separately retrieved OpenStreetMap footprint (way 156343656, public API snapshot retained in research inputs) spans approximately 41.62×27.31 m before cardinal-axis simplification. This supports the selected 41.8×27.7 m interpretation, but is a mapping estimate rather than construction measurement. The map omits some upper-level/projection details visible on the 1917 plan. Source: https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/156343656/full ; attribution © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

Structural bar16.16×66.36m; interpreted eave25.8m and ridge27.3m. Metres, nominal east+X/north+Y, groundZ0, centred footprint pivot; main/LODs/glass share one frame. Horizontal measurements derive from supplemental OpenStreetMap outline, not a survey. No measured campus transform. Roof is a low red-tile hip supported by the university illustration and Ludowici primary reroof case study listing Levi/Classic14-inch Clay Red tile. Roof pitch and ridge height remain interpreted, not measured; this evidence overrides the secondary OSM flat-roof tag. Short-end window count is interpreted. See documentation/geometry_evidence.json for source and uncertainty.
- https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/152284265 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; mapped envelope reference only)

Goodspeed is approximately 25.3 m long with a 13.3 m main depth, from OpenStreetMap way156343665. Gates–Blake is about 57.4 m in the mapped envelope (way156343657); the model's inferred central Gates and Blake lengths are 32.0 and 25.2 m. Those subdivisions are not separately surveyed measurements. Overall heights, window subdivisions, roof pitch, shallow west bay depths, carving and steps are photo-estimated. The model uses cardinal orientation; GIS suggests a small deviation west of true north. Sources: https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/156343665/full and https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/156343657/full ; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

OpenStreetMap way 143457513 gives an irregular envelope approximately 94.4m east-west by 32.7m north-south. This is a community-mapped outline, not a survey. Its broad massing agrees with official floor plans. Coordinates are in ../saieh_reference/osm_coordinates.txt relative to the southwest bounding-box corner (x east, y north); minor skew may be regularized for the asset. Important approximate zones:
- Local osm.xml and osm_coordinates.txt. Approximate mapped outer envelope only; attribution OpenStreetMap contributors. This does not establish surveyed dimensions

- Current mapped outline: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/154421807 . Retrieved version 6, 2024-05-17; OSM contributors, ODbL. Used as a qualitative plan/adjacency and proportion cross-check, not traced as measured survey control. Shows Hitchcock E–W and Snell N–S west arm, courtyard opening southeast, northwest tower and southeast library bay. Its whole-group envelope includes projections and cannot replace the historical 200 ft principal length. Map's building-level tag is not used as an authoritative floor count.

OpenStreetMap way 156343662 provides an approximately 43.21×25.49 m maximum envelope. Its main long range is about 18.7 m deep; the western entry/tower zone projects south, and the eastern end has a chamfer. This model uses a cardinal-axis simplification of those mapped relationships. Source: https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/156343662/full ; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. This is a GIS estimate, not a surveyed construction plan.

- OpenStreetMap ways156044638,156044639,156044642,156044643 provide mapped plan proportions and approximate horizontal scale. Source snapshot and exact source outline coordinates are retained separately. ©OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright . These are not surveyed dimensions. The model regularizes near-parallel walls and interprets ornament.
